sources.snippet: AI-powered Invoice Extractor built using OCR and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically extract invoice details from PDFs and scanned documents. The system processes invoices, identifies key fields such as invoice number, vendor name, GST, tax amount, and total amount, and converts them into structured formats like JSON or Excel.
